concerns.text: FR‑001 – Load univariate time series with ≥1,000 observations – is not explicitly covered by any task. T005 runs a minimal dataset but does not verify the ≥1,000‑observation requirement nor the normalization step required by FR‑001.
FR‑011 & FR‑012 – Sample‑size check and mandatory bootstrap resampling when anomalies < 10 – only a flag is set in T008; no task actually performs the bootstrap inference required by FR‑012.

FR‑017 & FR‑017b – Search for real‑world datasets with known regime shifts and produce a ‘Validation Deferred’ report if none are found – T003 only downloads verified datasets; it does not perform the required keyword‑based search or generate the deferred‑by‑design report.

FR‑019 – Train/validation/test split for threshold selection – no task creates or validates a data split before threshold calibration; T016 mentions threshold selection but does not enforce a split as mandated.
FR‑020 – Simulation study to verify the signal‑to‑noise ratio of the $\dot{\alpha}$ estimator – there is no task implementing the SNR simulation study; the requirement is completely uncovered.
FR‑021 – Synthetic data generator must model pre‑anomaly dynamics – while the synthetic generator exists, no task validates that it includes the required dynamics.
FR‑022 – Verification of the synthetic data generator’s logic – absent; no task checks that the generator’s output matches expected statistics.

Constitution Principle VII – Prior sensitivity analysis for the Dirichlet‑process concentration hyper‑parameter – the plan and tasks never vary the concentration prior or record the analysis, violating the constitution.
Task T004 removes a legacy `data/results/` directory that is never referenced elsewhere in the spec or plan, creating an unnecessary orphan task.
